created_by: A-lite CCP scenario-count validation, candidate-freeze step
selection_rule: Partition the verified clean pool by EXACT current-scan min_on_time_prob strata (0.885x2, 0.895x2, 0.900x2, 0.925x1, 0.930x1, 0.940x1, 0.960x1). For the four above-threshold strata, maximise binding-batch diversity subject to one candidate per stratum. Remaining ties broken deterministically by ascending canonical decision fingerprint (SHA-256 over batch keys, node sequences, mode sequences and shares). No manual cherry-picking. Cost, emissions, makespan, objective dominance and archived historical probabilities were NOT used to prefer any candidate.
scan_probability_caveat: scan_min_on_time_prob values were produced by a single fixed ScenarioSet (S=200, seed=42) and are used ONLY to stratify and select candidates. They are NOT evidence that S=200 is sufficient, and carry no convergence claim. Stage 1 must re-evaluate these candidates on its own scenario sets.
archived_probability_note: Historical probabilities recorded inside the source archives were produced under different configurations and were NOT used at any point in this selection.
known_binding_batch_limitation: Composition limitation, deliberately preserved and NOT corrected by generating new candidates: all 64 clean below-threshold candidates (0.86<=p<0.90) bind on batch 17, and all 22 clean p=0.900 candidates bind on batch 2. Within EVERY stratum the binding batch is constant, so the binding-batch diversity rule had no free choice to exercise. Stage 1 must stratify and report by bottleneck batch and must not treat this pool as representative across all 20 batches.

upstream_pool_scope.description: The Stage-1 boundary pool was formed by applying BOTH criterion A (numerical/structural eligibility) AND criterion B (near-threshold band). Criterion A alone is NOT the Stage-1 boundary pool.
criterion_A_eligibility_predicates: finite outputs (no NaN/Inf in min_on_time_prob, per-batch probabilities, or max_late_excess_h)
exact reconstructable decision structure (every path rebuilt via rebuild_path_from_nodes_modes(..., allow_road_fallback=False) with identical nodes and modes; no silent repair or road fallback)
upstream_pool_scope.explicit_disambiguation: 182 is NOT the Stage-1 boundary pool: it is merely the count of archive candidates passing the eligibility predicates at any probability. 100 IS the actual Stage-1 boundary pool (eligibility AND 0.86 <= p <= 0.96). The frozen subset of 10 was drawn only from those 100.

source_integrity.note: Content hashes of the exact input files used by the verified candidate-location scan that produced the 587-candidate pool. locate_scan_rows.json is the recorded per-candidate scan output (S=200, seed=42, risk_metric=ccp) and lives outside the repository in the session scratchpad; its path is recorded so the hash can be checked against the artefact that was actually used.
source_integrity.durable_scan_rows_note: expanda/a_lite_stage1_scan_rows.json is an EXACT, byte-for-byte preserved copy of the candidate-location scan evidence (locate_scan_rows.json) whose SHA-256 was already recorded in this block. It was NOT regenerated and the candidate-location scan was NOT rerun: the file was copied verbatim and its SHA-256 re-verified to be identical both before and after copying. No ScenarioSet was built or installed, no candidate was evaluated, and no NSGA-II was run in the step that created it. The original scratchpad path is retained below as historical provenance and is deliberately NOT deleted or overwritten.

candidates_integrity.canonicalisation: sha256 of json.dumps(candidates, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) over the ENTIRE candidates array, order-sensitive.
candidates_integrity.note: Recorded so that any future edit to the checkpoint can be proven not to have altered the frozen candidate set.
